source_uncertainties: All source videos were deliberately deleted before this work. Only retained publisher captions, 11 contact sheets and the 22 listed full board frames were used; no video playback or new frame extraction is claimed.
Title cards in publisher captions label the recordings Week04 Lecture11 and Lecture12. Course manifest/YouTube labels are Lecture9 and Lecture10, used here.

L9 frames31/35 warn against noninertial use of the displayed formula. The chapter distinguishes a moving geometric control volume with inertial momentum from an accelerating observer and derives the translation-only extension; this is an original teaching correction/extension, not attributed to the displayed lecture.

L10 writes tau for total stress and sigma_xx,sigma_yy for normal components. This chapter translates to accepted T_ij total, face-first indices, tau_bold viscous only. Board f27 and caption718-741 confirm first-index face.
The lecture derives incompressible constitutive closure only and explicitly defers compressible terms. Stokes hypothesis and bulk viscosity are research extensions, not lecture statements.
Nominal rho=1000 kg/m^3 is the lecture model. mu=0.001 Pa s and circular radius/thickness are explicitly chosen illustrations, not temperature-specific properties.

Initial self-check detected an incorrectly drafted planar beta=4/3. Corrected to beta=6/5 in derivation and code before successful output check.
